parents.title: Log-prime energies make the bosonic partition function exactly zeta

accepted_interpretation.interpretation: The primon gas realizes unique factorization as occupation-number bookkeeping. A prime p labels a one-particle level with energy proportional to log p; bosonic multiplicities are prime exponents, so each many-body state corresponds uniquely to an integer n and has total energy proportional to log n. Summing its Boltzmann weights is therefore the zeta Dirichlet series, whose pole becomes a Hagedorn divergence. Fermionic exclusion changes allowed exponents to zero or one and correspondingly changes the Euler factors and partition-function ratio.
